description: Source code for object file conversion functions in a Git-related project, including functions to convert object IDs, decode tree entries, and convert commit, tree, and tag objects between different hash algorithms.

methods.name: repo_oid_to_algop
methods.description: Converts an object ID from its current hash algorithm to a specified target algorithm, reloading the object map if necessary.

methods.name: decode_tree_entry_raw
methods.description: Decodes a raw tree entry from a buffer into an object ID and path.

methods.name: convert_tree_object
methods.description: Converts a tree object buffer from one hash algorithm to another, updating object IDs accordingly.

methods.name: convert_tag_object
methods.description: Converts a tag object buffer between hash algorithms, handling signatures and payloads.

methods.name: convert_commit_object
methods.description: Converts a commit object buffer between hash algorithms, updating tree, parent, and mergetag references.

methods.name: convert_object_file
methods.description: Main function to convert an object file of a specific type between hash algorithms, calling specific conversion functions.
